children: Yes Bank on Saturday reported a 65 per cent year-on-year jump in second-quarter profit to ₹1,080 crore ($114 million), but said the figure did not reflect the impact of a Supreme Court ruling this week that set aside its 2020 write-off of ₹8,400 crore ($884 million) in additional tier-1 bonds.
Had the impact been recognised, the bank would have posted a quarterly loss of ₹5,217 crore, it said in a filing.

title: YES Bank reports quarterly profit but flags impact of Supreme Court ruling on AT-1 bonds
